description: Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI) Recent Conditions is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri. Droughts are natural disasters characterized by atypical dry conditions and high temperatures that persist over a period of time. Droughts disturb natural ecosystems and human activities such as food production. The Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI) is used for the analysis and monitoring of drought events. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri. Its keywords are Drought, Precipitation, Evapotranspiration, Environment, Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index, SPEI, Live Feeds, livefeeds2. The bounding box given is -173.6594,-50.0000,-179.6415,50.2749. The hub shows 2026-06-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Esri Master License Agreement (terms of use of the source layer, not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
